verdict.rationale: Community evidence indicates DeepSeek ships open, locally-runnable weights (e.g., R1-Distill-Llama-8B, ~154GB native V4-Flash weights usable locally) and is described as 'open-source', but the evidence pack contains no first-party statement of a specific license or official download/model-card instructions. Missing for 10: explicit license text (e.g., MIT/Apache), official weight download page, and confirmation of terms for commercial use.
